heading: Postal matters
lead: The district courts shall have original jurisdiction of any civil action arising under any Act of Congress relating to the postal service.

notes.text: Historical and Revision NotesBased on title 28, U.S.C., 1940 ed., § 41(6) (Mar. 3, 1911, ch. 231, § 24, par. 6, 36 Stat. 1092). Changes were made in phraseology.
